data.name: Lord of Kensai
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Katana-Ra: Become the Shogun of Your Own Destiny

Build, manage, and defend your Japanese-inspired metropolis in Lord of Kensai, a strategic city builder set in the vibrant and dangerous Katana-Ra universe. Balance the needs of your growing populace with the demands of rival factions, all while mastering the shifting tides of nature and war.

Key Features

  • Strategic Faction Dynamics: Forge alliances or spark rivalries with powerful local factions. Navigate complex diplomatic challenges where every decision impacts your city's stability and resources.

  • Dynamic Environments: Adapt your infrastructure to survive a living world. Watch your city transform through stunning, full-cycle day/night transitions and the harsh, game-changing realities of the four seasons.

  • Dual-Layer Strategy: Manage the micro-details of your city layout to optimize production, then zoom out to face critical challenges on the expansive world map.

  • In-Depth Building Systems: Utilize a modular building suite to create unique districts, fortify your borders, and honor your culture with intricate traditional architecture.

  • Accessible Mastery: Designed with an intuitive interface that welcomes newcomers to the genre, while providing the deep, layered complexity that seasoned city-building veterans demand.

Forge a Legacy in Katana-Ra

In Lord of Kensai, you are more than just an architect; you are the heartbeat of a new civilization. As the winds of change blow through the Katana-Ra universe, your ability to plan, react, and govern will determine whether your city becomes a legendary stronghold or a footnote in history.

Will you build a peaceful haven of commerce and culture, or a fortified bastion capable of weathering any storm? The challenges are constant, the seasons are unforgiving, and the factions are watching.

Plan your path, command your citizens, and ascend to become the ultimate Lord of Kensai.

Will your city survive the shifting seasons?

Add Lord of Kensai to your Wishlist to stay updated on our development journey and be the first to know when the gates open.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i7
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 3000 series or higher equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Core i7
  • Memory: 12 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 4000 series or higher equivalent RTX
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
